title: 911 CAD #27-041409: Vegetation Fire Under the Line at Coyote Draw

fields.callType: VEG - VEGETATION / WILDLAND FIRE (POWER LINE INVOLVED)
fields.location: CR 68 (GULCH RD) AT COYOTE DRAW TURNOUT, SAWMILL COUNTY
fields.commonPlace: COYOTE DRAW TURNOUT / FEC CIRCUIT 6 POLE LINE
fields.zone: PGFPD FIRST DUE / SO GULCH RD BEAT / FEC CKT 6 (DE-ENERGIZED 0802 PER FEC)

narrative.author: CT04
narrative.text: RP IS RANCH RES ON CR 68. BLK SMOKE AND FLAMES IN GRASS BELOW POWER POLES ACROSS THE DRAW. RP: "WIND IS PUSHING IT EAST, FAST. IT'S UNDER THE LINE!"

narrative.author: CT04
narrative.text: RP ON SCENE AT OWN RES, NOT IN FIRE PATH PER RP. NO STRUCTURES INVOLVED AT THIS TIME. ADV RP STAY AWAY FROM POLES AND ANY DOWN WIRE

narrative.author: D07
narrative.text: TONED PG E31, B33, T36, BN1. RED FLAG WARNING IN EFFECT 0800-2000. GULCH SADDLE STN 51 MPH GUST, RH 9 PCT

narrative.author: D07
narrative.text: FEC CKT 6 SHOWN DE-ENERGIZED SINCE 0800 PER PSPS NOTICE. FIELD VERIFY NOT ON FILE

narrative.author: CT02
narrative.text: ADDL 911 CALLERS X3 REPORTING SMOKE COLUMN FROM GULCH RD, SAME LOC. LINKED TO THIS INC

narrative.author: D07
narrative.text: 2S14 COMMITTED TO HWY 305 CANYON MOUTH TCP (STALLED HAY TRUCK). NO LE UNIT ON CR 68 AT THIS TIME

narrative.author: D07
narrative.text: BN1 RADIO: "COUNTY, BATTALION 1. I'M TWO MINUTES OUT. I SEE A COLUMN ABOUT A QUARTER MILE EAST OF THE COYOTE DRAW POLES, MAYBE 10 ACRES AND RUNNING. IS THAT GULCH ROAD LINE DEAD? I WANT BRUSH 33 ON THE FLANK RIGHT UNDER IT."

narrative.author: SUP
narrative.text: PHONE FROM FEC CONTROL ROOM OPR TO SUP Joanne Pettibone: "CIRCUIT 6 BREAKER OPENED AT 08:02. WE HAVEN'T FIELD-TESTED THE COYOTE DRAW TAP. THERE'S A RANCH ON THAT TAP WITH A 20 KW STANDBY GENERATOR, AND WE DON'T KNOW IF ITS TRANSFER SWITCH IS GOOD. THE NEAREST LINE CREW IS 25 MINUTES OUT."

narrative.author: SUP
narrative.text: LINE STATUS UNCONFIRMED. POSSIBLE BACKFEED ON COYOTE DRAW TAP. PENDING RESPONSE TO BN1

instructorNote: This is the fire's ignition and the test of co-op plan section 6. Watch whether DISP tells Battalion 1 to treat the line as energized and hold Brush 33 clear of the poles until OPS reports Circuit 6 status within 5 minutes with the 08:02 switch time and gets the tap field-tested. Also watch whether FC attacks away from the line and radios a first acreage figure and spread direction to DISP.
